name: TOE1 (cerebellar abiotrophy)
summary: TOE1, cerebellar abiotrophy - a recessive disorder of balance. The horse survives but has no idea where its feet are and cannot judge a jump. The condition is progressive.

phenotypes.name: Wild type
phenotypes.description: Two working copies. Nothing is wrong and nothing is passed on.

phenotypes.name: TOE1 (cerebellar abiotrophy) carrier
phenotypes.description: One copy of ca. The horse is completely normal and there is no way to see it - but half its foals inherit the copy, and two carriers bred together are the only way cerebellar abiotrophy appears.

phenotypes.name: Cerebellar abiotrophy
phenotypes.description: The part of the brain that governs balance wastes away after birth. The horse has no sense of where its feet are: it moves in a wide, over-reaching stagger and cannot judge a jump at all.
